{{Quote|But now an ''upstart nationalist'' is trying to ''reclaim'' Skako Minor.|[[ZED-6-7]], to [[Sabé]]|<ref name="Vader 28" />}}
Between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> amid both the [[Galactic Civil War]] and [[Crimson Dawn]]'s [[war against the Sith]], the [[Skakoan]]<ref name="Vader 29" /> nationalist<ref name="Vader 28" /> [[Jul Tambor]] led an '''uprising on Skako Minor''',<ref name="Vader 29" /> also known as '''Jul Tambor's Insurgency''',<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> to reclaim the [[planet]] [[Skako Minor]] from a [[Skakoan Council|regime]] loyal to the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Vader 28" />
